name: Covidence Canonical Article Dedupe Foundation
description: Implement the Covidence-first vertical slice for canonical article dedupe, scoped import metadata, marts, judgment snapshot compatibility, and client source-link alignment.

userStories.title: Add Identifier Normalization Utilities
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need shared identifier normalization so all importers match canonical articles with the same rules.
acceptanceCriteria: DOI, PMID, arXiv, bioRxiv URL, and medRxiv URL inputs normalize according to the normalization contract.
DOI-shaped bioRxiv and medRxiv values are returned as DOI identifiers, not source-specific strong kinds.
PMCID values are normalized only for metadata or candidate reporting and are not returned as strong identifiers.
Malformed and disagreeing source-row identifiers are represented as rejected or conflicted outcomes with enough detail for quarantine.
Targeted identifier normalization tests cover boundary, malformed, duplicate, and disagreement cases.
bun run lint passes.
Run the narrowest targeted bun test command for changed files, or document why no targeted test exists.

userStories.title: Add Canonical Identifier Schema
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need a canonical identifier table and a non-unique legacy article id lookup surface so strong identifiers can drive matching instead of route-prefixed ids.
acceptanceCriteria: A DuckDB migration adds app.article_identifier with article_id, kind, normalized_value, source/provenance fields, timestamps, and a unique (kind, normalized_value) constraint.
The schema migration removes the canonical uniqueness dependency on app.article.article_id and leaves only a compatibility lookup surface for legacy reads.
New canonical article rows can have NULL legacy article_id values.
bun run db:mig succeeds.
bun run lint passes.
Run the narrowest targeted bun test command for changed files, or document why no targeted test exists.

userStories.title: Expand Import-Scoped Article Records
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need import-scoped article records to own source-facing ids, raw payloads, source-record identity, and retry idempotency.
acceptanceCriteria: app.article_import_route stores external_article_id, source kind, import metadata, match metadata, import-run reference, source record key, source record hash, and timestamps.
The chosen current-membership or child-row design enforces source-record idempotency without relying only on UNIQUE(article_id, import_route_id).
Repeated source rows with the same key and hash are idempotent, changed hashes update or version the source row, and remaps to a different canonical article are quarantined.
Migration and schema tests cover nullable legacy rows and the final uniqueness surface.
bun run db:mig succeeds.
bun run lint passes.

userStories.title: Add Canonical Field Resolver
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need a deterministic resolver so live imports and historical merges update canonical article fields consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: The resolver implements source trust order, completeness tie-breaks, canonical URL precedence, publication-status non-downgrade, full-text hint union, and material scalar conflict warnings.
Manual or operator-curated values win until explicitly cleared.
Resolver tests prove reruns are stable and do not overwrite article fields by last-writer-wins behavior.
bun run lint passes.
Run the narrowest targeted bun test command for changed files, or document why no targeted test exists.

userStories.title: Add Batch Canonical Matcher
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need one batch matcher that reuses or creates canonical articles from normalized candidates without per-row full-table lookups.
acceptanceCriteria: The matcher accepts bounded batches of normalized article candidates and returns explicit reuse, create, or unresolved outcomes.
Duplicate identifiers inside one batch collapse before canonical writes.
Multiple strong identifiers auto-merge only when every existing match points to the same canonical article.
Identifier insert conflicts re-read the winning row and quarantine conflicting canonical article mappings.
Query-shape tests or instrumentation prove strong matching uses app.article_identifier lookups instead of JSON scans or full app.article scans.
bun run lint passes.
Run the narrowest targeted bun test command for changed files, or document why no targeted test exists.

userStories.title: Wire Article Import Store To Canonical Matching
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need the shared article import store to write canonical articles, identifiers, and scoped import records through the new matcher.
acceptanceCriteria: articleImportStoreService stops using ON CONFLICT(article_id), WHERE article_id IN (...), or route-prefixed legacy ids as the canonical match path.
Each bounded write chunk commits canonical article creation, identifier insertion, and import-scoped record insertion atomically.
Import-scoped records write source-facing ids to external_article_id and update unchanged repeated harvest rows only when source_record_hash changes.
Targeted articleImportStoreService tests cover duplicate strong identifiers, retry idempotency, and source-record remap quarantine.
bun run lint passes.

userStories.title: Refactor Covidence Import To Reuse Canonical Articles
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want overlapping Covidence imports to reuse one canonical article while preserving project-specific Covidence metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: Covidence import no longer mints covidence:<datasourceId>:<articleKey> as canonical article identity.
Two Covidence imports with overlapping DOI, PMID, arXiv, or DOI-shaped preprint values reuse one canonical article row.
Study keys, record keys, article keys, notes, tags, stage membership, duplicate flags, and seeded human answer metadata are stored on import-scoped records.
Covidence project-scope and seeded-human-answer lookups resolve through import-scoped records or the explicit compatibility adapter.
Targeted Covidence import tests pass for duplicate package, overlapping package, and seeded-answer scenarios.

acceptanceCriteria: Covidence prompt creation uses the same reuse semantics as immutablePromptService.
Covidence section and criteria metadata remain on app.project_prompt.
Archived prompt rows do not create content-hash conflicts.
Targeted prompt reuse tests cover repeated and archived Covidence prompt definitions.

userStories.title: Add Scoped Article Read Compatibility
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I need review and article APIs to expose canonical article fields separately from project-scoped import metadata during the migration.
acceptanceCriteria: Shared query helpers expose canonical article fields, canonical metadata, selected external_article_id, selected import record id, and scoped import metadata without parsing app.article.article_id.
Review list, review detail, human-review filters, warning, health, export, and batch article paths read scoped import metadata where relevant.
Compatibility reads can derive legacy importRoute and originalData only through the adapter during the migration window.
Targeted route and query tests pass for project-scoped article display, related-record lookup, filters, and export identity.

userStories.title: Preserve Judgment Snapshot And Queue Replay Context
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need queued judgments and saved snapshots to remain reproducible while article import data moves to scoped records.
acceptanceCriteria: New snapshot and prompt payloads include canonical article fields plus the project-scoped external id and import metadata required by the prompt context.
Existing queued work and saved snapshots can replay legacy importRoute, originalData, and article id fields through a compatibility adapter.
Outbox import, completion journal, and prompt payload paths canonicalize article ids before writing new app-owned state.
Targeted judgment queue, outbox, completion journal, and prompt payload tests cover old and new payload shapes.

userStories.title: Build Project-Scoped Review Serving Marts
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I need review marts to denormalize the selected project-scoped import record instead of article-global Covidence metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: Review serving builders select scoped import records by the documented deterministic policy.
article_external_id comes from the selected project-scoped import record, and serving metadata combines canonical article metadata with scoped import metadata.
Dirty state and refresh work are scoped to affected project and article ids instead of relying on article-global metadata readers.
Incremental refresh and large rebuild produce the same serving shape for the same project scope.
Targeted review mart, dirty refresh, and large-rebuild tests pass.

userStories.title: Verify First-Loop Integration
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need an end-to-end check proving the first Ralph loop can ship without breaking browser, desktop, judgment, or mart behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Re-importing the same Covidence package creates no additional canonical articles for repeated strong identifiers or repeated source rows.
Importing an overlapping package from another source reuses Covidence-created canonical articles for DOI, PMID, arXiv, and DOI-shaped preprint matches.
Project-scoped Covidence metadata, related-record views, filters, displayed external ids, and PDF fetch behavior still work in browser review flows.
Desktop Covidence create and review flow still works for the shared serving payload shape.
